en: The Bun Router also doesn't stop at basic
routes like that.
You can also register routes that include
path parameters
like here where I get some course ID.
This is the syntax for setting up a dynamic
path with the Bun Router. So you're telling
Bun that you got a /courses/some ID route
where you don't know the ID in advance, it
can be different IDs.
And then this handler function here will
become active whenever this route is hit.
So if I save this
and I go to /courses/abc,
you'll see
course ID abc here because that is the
response I am returning here, no fancy HTML
page because of this dynamic route.
So the Bun Router also supports dynamic
routes like this.
